item.title: She Said It Was An Accident Then The Evidence Changed Everything
item.description: Abigail White and Bradley Lewis had a turbulent relationship that ended after Lewis told her he wanted to leave. On March 25, 2022, White fatally stabbed Lewis at their home in Kingswood, South Gloucestershire. She claimed she had not intended to kill him, but a jury convicted her, and she was sentenced to life in prison with a minimum term of 18 years.

item.title: She Went On Honeymoon Then A Taxi Ride Changed Everything
item.description: Anni Dewani was on honeymoon with her husband Shrien in Cape Town when their taxi was hijacked on November 13, 2010. Anni was later found dead in the abandoned vehicle, and the investigation raised questions about whether the attack was a random hijacking or something more deliberate. Shrien Dewani was ultimately acquitted in 2014 after the case against him collapsed.

item.title: He Thought He Knew Her Then His Obsession Took A Dark Turn
item.description: Robert Bardo became obsessed with actress Rebecca Schaeffer after watching her on My Sister Sam. He repeatedly tried to contact her, eventually obtained her home address through a private investigator, and traveled to Los Angeles. Bardo was convicted in 1991 and sentenced to life without parole, while Schaeffer’s case helped drive major changes to California stalking and privacy laws.

item.title: She Said Her Mother Was Someone Else Then The Truth Emerged
item.description: In August 2013, 18 year old Isabella Guzman was arrested after her mother, Yun Mi Hoy, was found dead in their Aurora, Colorado, home. Doctors later testified that Guzman was experiencing severe schizophrenia and delusions at the time. In 2014, she was found not guilty by reason of insanity and committed to a state mental hospital indefinitely.

item.title: She Vanished From Her Home Then Walked Out Of A Remote Cabin
item.description: Thirteen year old Jayme Closs disappeared from her Wisconsin home in October 2018 after Jake Patterson abducted her and her parents were found dead. She remained captive for 88 days before escaping from a remote cabin and finding help. Patterson later pleaded guilty and received two life sentences without parole plus an additional sentence for kidnapping.

item.title: His Children Vanished And A Traffic Stop Changed Everything
item.description: In August 2014, Timothy Jones Jr.’s five children disappeared from their home in Lexington County, South Carolina. Jones was arrested days later at a traffic stop in Mississippi, and investigators eventually located the children’s remains in Alabama. He was convicted in 2019 and sentenced to death, a sentence upheld by the South Carolina Supreme Court in 2023.

item.title: Her Daughter Fell Ill Then Police Started Asking Questions
item.description: Mark Staudte died in 2012, followed five months later by his son Shaun. When daughter Sarah became critically ill in 2013, an anonymous tip led police to reopen the deaths. Investigators discovered Diane Staudte and her daughter Rachel were responsible, and both eventually received life sentences.

item.title: He Built A Religious Community Then Everything Started Falling Apart
item.description: Roch Thériault founded the Ant Hill Kids in Canada in the late 1970s, presenting himself as a spiritual leader named Moses. The isolated community eventually came under his strict control, and authorities removed children from the group before Thériault was arrested in 1989. He was later convicted of second degree murder and sentenced to life in prison.

item.title: He Said His Family Was In Danger Then Police Turned On Him
item.description: Chris Coleman reported receiving threatening messages before his wife Sheri and their two sons, Garett and Gavin, were found dead in their Illinois home in May 2009. Investigators later determined that Coleman was responsible, and he was convicted of three counts of first degree murder and sentenced to three consecutive life terms without parole.

item.title: She Couldn’t Let Him Go Then Investigators Uncovered The Plan
item.description: Brenda Delgado became fixated on her former boyfriend Ricardo Paniagua after he began dating Dallas dentist Kendra Hatcher. Prosecutors said Delgado recruited Crystal Cortes and Kristopher Love to target Hatcher in 2015, then fled to Mexico. Delgado was arrested in 2016, convicted in 2019, and sentenced to life without parole. Her conviction was upheld on appeal in 2021.
